correctness.rationale: Independent regeneration of all 384 signed-permutation B4 elements, sixteen coordinate and signed-swap reflections, exact shortest reflection lengths [1,16,86,176,105], absolute Coxeter interval 70 elements of ranks [1,16,36,16,1]. Its proper order complex has 68/288/256 chains; Coxeter conjugation rank preserves flags and without inversions gives orbit 18/72/64 cells. Independent exact integer matrices satisfy d1*d2=0, with SNF(d1) seventeen unit factors and SNF(d2) fifty-four unit factors and a single two. Since im d1 is primitive, H1 torsion exactly Z2 with zero free rank, and ker d2 has free rank 64-55=9; H0=Z. This is an exhaustive finite B4 result, not an assertion for other ranks or fundamental group.
